#Pseudobulk DE aggregation by sample (for instance cl6_WT_P2_E8_n1) and cluster (so it becomes cl6_WT_P2_E8_n1_1 ecc...)

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)

seurat <- seurat_AB04
Idents(seurat) <- "monocle_clusters"
## COSTRUISCI meta_to_use DAL META.DATA DI SEURAT
meta_to_use <- seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    monocle_clusters,
    samp,
    media,
    type,
  )

## Crea pb_group USANDO meta_to_use (non meta!)
meta_to_use$pb_group <- interaction(
  meta_to_use$sample_id,
  meta_to_use$monocle_clusters,
  sep  = "__",
  drop = TRUE
)

## Scrivi pb_group dentro Seurat (stesso ordine delle celle)
seurat$pb_group <- meta_to_use$pb_group
## COSTRUISCI pb_meta come nel tuo schema (usa esattamente gli stessi campi)
pb_meta <- meta_to_use %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pb_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sample_id        = dplyr::first(sample_id),
    monocle_clusters = dplyr::first(monocle_clusters),
    samp             = dplyr::first(samp),
    media            = dplyr::first(media),
    type             = dplyr::first(type),
    n_cells          = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pb_group")


###aggregate counts per sample×cluster
agg <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat,
  assays  = "originalexp",  # o l'assay giusto
  slot    = "counts",
  group.by = "pb_group",
  fun     = "sum"
)

pb_counts <- as.matrix(agg$originalexp)

## 1) Porta i rownames di pb_meta nello stesso formato di pb_counts
rownames(pb_meta) <- gsub("_", "-", rownames(pb_meta))
# questo converte: cl6_WT_P2_E8_n3__7  ->  cl6-WT-P2-E8-n3--7

## 2) Diagnostica e allineamento robusto
pb_groups_counts <- colnames(pb_counts)
pb_groups_meta   <- rownames(pb_meta)

missing_in_meta   <- setdiff(pb_groups_counts, pb_groups_meta)
missing_in_counts <- setdiff(pb_groups_meta, pb_groups_counts)

cat("N gruppi in pb_counts: ", length(pb_groups_counts), "\n")
cat("N gruppi in pb_meta:   ", length(pb_groups_meta), "\n")
cat("Solo in counts: ", length(missing_in_meta), "\n")
cat("Solo in meta:   ", length(missing_in_counts), "\n")

# Usa solo i gruppi comuni (per sicurezza)
common_groups <- intersect(pb_groups_counts, pb_groups_meta)

if (length(common_groups) < 2) {
  stop("Troppi pochi gruppi comuni tra pb_counts e pb_meta per fare DESeq2.")
}

pb_counts <- pb_counts[, common_groups, drop = FALSE]
pb_meta   <- pb_meta[common_groups, , drop = FALSE]

# Ordine identico
pb_meta <- pb_meta[colnames(pb_counts), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(pb_counts), rownames(pb_meta)))

## 2) PREPARA DESeq2 #all samples and clusters
pb_meta$monocle_clusters <- factor(pb_meta$monocle_clusters)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb_counts),
  colData   = pb_meta,
  design    = ~ monocle_clusters   # qui usi solo il cluster come effetto
)

pb_metaWT=subset(pb_meta,pb_meta$type=="WT")
dds_WT <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb_counts[,rownames(pb_metaWT)]),
  colData   = pb_metaWT,
  design    = ~ monocle_clusters   # qui usi solo il cluster come effetto
)

pb_metaNO=subset(pb_meta,pb_meta$type=="NANOG_OVER")
dds_NO <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb_counts[,rownames(pb_metaNO)]),
  colData   = pb_metaNO,
  design    = ~ monocle_clusters   # qui usi solo il cluster come effetto
)

# Filtra geni poco espressi
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]
dds_WT <- dds_WT[rowSums(counts(dds_WT)) >= 10, ]
dds_NO <- dds_NO[rowSums(counts(dds_NO)) >= 10, ]

# Run DESeq
dds <- DESeq(dds)
dds_WT <- DESeq(dds_WT)
dds_NO <- DESeq(dds_NO)

## 3) PCA con VST
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
vsd_WT <- vst_WT(dds_WT, blind = TRUE)
vsd_NO <- vst_NO(dds_NO, blind = TRUE)

pcaData <- plotPCA(
  vsd,
  intgroup   = c("monocle_clusters", "media", "type"),
  returnData = TRUE
)

percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2,
                             color = monocle_clusters,
                             shape = type)) + ###need to add treatment maybe
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% var")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% var")) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("PCA_pseudobulk_monocle_clusters_all.pdf", p_pca, width = 6, height = 5)
```

###compare WT which has only 1 and 2 clusters

```{r}
## 4) COMPARAZIONI DE: cluster vs cluster (tutti i pairwise)
#cluster_levels <- levels(pb_metaWT$monocle_clusters)
cluster_levels <- c("1","2")

pairwise_list <- list()
k <- 1
for (i in seq_along(cluster_levels)) {
  for (j in seq_along(cluster_levels)) {
    if (i >= j) next   # evita duplicati e self-comparison

    ci <- cluster_levels[i]
    cj <- cluster_levels[j]

    res_ij <- results(dds_WT, contrast = c("monocle_clusters", ci, cj))
    res_df <- as.data.frame(res_ij)
    res_df$gene       <- rownames(res_df)
    res_df$comparison <- paste0(ci, "_vs_", cj)
    res_df$cluster_A  <- ci
    res_df$cluster_B  <- cj

    pairwise_list[[k]] <- res_df
    k <- k + 1
  }
}

res_pairwise <- bind_rows(pairwise_list)
res_WT=res_pairwise

## soglie che puoi cambiare
lfc_thr  <- 1        # |log2FC| >= 1
padj_thr <- 0.05     # FDR < 0.05

res_WT <- res_WT %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >=  lfc_thr ~ "Up",
      !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thr ~ "Down",
      TRUE                                                            ~ "NS"
    )
  )

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_DESeq2_pseudobulk_monocle_clusters_WT_comparisons.tsv")
# opzionale: salva su file
write.table(
  res_WT,
  file      = stat_filename,
  sep       = "\t",
  quote     = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


res_sig <- res_WT %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(padj),
    padj < padj_thr,
    abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thr
  )

## TOP UP-regolati per confronto (es. primi 50)
top_up_by_comparison <- res_sig %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank_up = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rank_up <= 50) %>%
  ungroup()

## TOP DOWN-regolati per confronto (es. primi 50)
top_down_by_comparison <- res_sig %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange, .by_group = TRUE) %>%  # più negativi in alto
  mutate(rank_down = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rank_down <= 50) %>%
  ungroup()

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_DESeq2_top50_up_by_comparison_WT_cl1hPSC.tsv")
write.table(
  top_up_by_comparison,
  file      = stat_filename,
  sep       = "\t",
  quote     = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_DESeq2_top50_down_by_comparison_WT_cl2Neur.tsv")
write.table(
  top_down_by_comparison,
  file      = stat_filename,
  sep       = "\t",
  quote     = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ok_pal <- c(
  "Up"   = "#CC79A7",
  "Down" = "#009E73",
  "NS"   = "grey70"
)

EnhancedVolcano(
    res_WT,
    lab = res_WT$gene,
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'padj',
    pCutoff  = padj_thr,
    FCcutoff = lfc_thr,
    
    title    = "cl 1 vs cl 2 (WT only)",
    subtitle = 'Volcano Plot',
    caption  = paste0('padj < ', padj_thr, '  |  |log2FC| > ', lfc_thr),
    
    pointSize = 2,
    
    ## colori personalizzati
    colCustom = ok_pal[res_WT$direction],
    colAlpha  = 0.5,
    
    ## connettori
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.1,
    colConnectors   = 'black',
    
    ## label appearance
    labSize      = 2.5,
    boxedLabels  = FALSE,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    
    legendLabSize  = 10,
    legendIconSize = 3.5,
    borderWidth    = 0.1,
    axisLabSize    = 12
  ) +
    theme(
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
    )
  
ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_volcano_", "1vs2", "_WT_pseudobulk.pdf"),
    width    = 6,
    height   = 7
  )

```

####GSEA on pseudobulk analysis WT only (cl 1 vs cl 2)

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(DOSE)
library(dplyr)


res_WT$gene_name=res_WT$gene
set_min_n_genes <- 5

## prendi solo i confronti cluster vs rest
#cl_vs_rest <- unique(res_all$comparison[grepl("vs_rest$", res_all$comparison)])
cl_vs_rest <- unique(res_WT$comparison)
cl_vs_rest
# controlla che siano quelli che ti aspetti: es. "7_vs_rest", "3_vs_rest", ...

## Costruisci le ranked lists: named numeric vector (values = log2FC, names = SYMBOL)
gene_sets_GSEA <- list()

for (comp in cl_vs_rest) {
  df_comp <- res_WT %>%
    filter(comparison == comp, !is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) 
  
  ## usa gene_name come SYMBOL (se non l'hai, vedi commento sotto)
  df_comp <- df_comp %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "")
  
  if (!nrow(df_comp)) {
    message("No genes for comparison ", comp, " – skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  ranks <- df_comp$log2FoldChange
  names(ranks) <- df_comp$gene_name
  
  ## ordina decrescente come richiesto da gseGO
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  gene_sets_GSEA[[comp]] <- ranks
}

## Controllo di sicurezza
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && length(x) > 0 && !is.null(names(x))))
)

# Se NON hai `gene_name` ma solo `gene` con SYMBOL, sostituisci sopra `gene_name` con `gene`.
## Mappa tutti i SYMBOL che compaiono in qualsiasi ranked list
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]
  
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym),
                   rank   = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by = "SYMBOL")
  
  if (!nrow(df2)) {
    message("No ENTREZ mapping for ", nm, " – skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  ## deduplico per ENTREZ tenendo il gene con |rank| maggiore
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]
  
  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  gsea <- suppressMessages(
    gseGO(
      geneList      = ranks_entrez,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      ont           = "BP",
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      nPermSimple   = 10000,
      by            = "fgsea",
      verbose       = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  if (is.null(gsea) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea)) == 0L) {
    message("No enriched terms for ", nm)
    gsea_list[[nm]]   <- NULL
    GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  ## rendo leggibili i geni
  gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea,
                               OrgDb  = org.Hs.eg.db,
                               keyType = "ENTREZID")
  
  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea_readable
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

## 4a. Scrivi le tabelle GSEA in CSV
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GSEA_pseudobulk_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

## 4b. Funzione helper per salvare plot
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

## 4c. Dotplot per ciascun confronto cluster vs rest
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10,
                               width = 8, height = 10) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    if (is.null(g)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (NULL).")
      next
    }
    
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }
    
    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))
    
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_pseudobulk_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_GO, show_k = 15)

Rdata_filename <- paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_GSEA_pseudobulk_WT.RData")
save(gene_sets_GSEA, gsea_list, GSEA_tables, res_WT,
     file = Rdata_filename)
```

```{r}
## 4) COMPARAZIONI DE: cluster vs cluster (tutti i pairwise)
#cluster_levels <- levels(pb_metaNO$monocle_clusters)
cluster_levels=c("3","4","5")

pairwise_list <- list()
k <- 1
for (i in seq_along(cluster_levels)) {
  for (j in seq_along(cluster_levels)) {
    if (i >= j) next   # evita duplicati e self-comparison

    ci <- cluster_levels[i]
    cj <- cluster_levels[j]

    res_ij <- results(dds_NO, contrast = c("monocle_clusters", ci, cj))
    res_df <- as.data.frame(res_ij)
    res_df$gene       <- rownames(res_df)
    res_df$comparison <- paste0(ci, "_vs_", cj)
    res_df$cluster_A  <- ci
    res_df$cluster_B  <- cj

    pairwise_list[[k]] <- res_df
    k <- k + 1
  }
}

res_pairwise <- bind_rows(pairwise_list)

## 5) COMPARAZIONI one-vs-rest (cluster vs tutti gli altri) – versione “safe”

one_vs_rest_list <- list()
k <- 1

for (cl in cluster_levels) {
  message("Running one-vs-rest for cluster ", cl)
  
  dds_tmp <- dds_NO
  
  ## definisci il fattore group_ovr: cluster vs REST
  dds_tmp$group_ovr <- ifelse(dds_tmp$monocle_clusters == cl, cl, "REST")
  dds_tmp$group_ovr <- factor(dds_tmp$group_ovr,
                              levels = c("REST", cl))  # REST è il riferimento
  
  design(dds_tmp) <- ~ group_ovr
  
  ## re-fit
  dds_tmp <- DESeq(dds_tmp)
  
  ## controlla i nomi dei coefficienti, così sei sicura di usare quello giusto
  rn <- resultsNames(dds_tmp)
  print(rn)
  ## ci sarà qualcosa tipo "group_ovr_cl7_vs_REST" se cl == "7"
  
  coef_name_pattern <- paste0("group_ovr_", cl, "_vs_REST")
  coef_name <- rn[grepl(coef_name_pattern, rn)]
  
  if (length(coef_name) != 1) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify coefficient for cluster ", cl,
         ". Found: ", paste(rn, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  ## questo è per definizione log2(cl / REST)
  res_cl <- results(dds_tmp, name = coef_name)
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res_cl)
  res_df$gene       <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df$comparison <- paste0(cl, "_vs_rest")   # il nome riflette cl/REST
  res_df$cluster    <- cl
  
  one_vs_rest_list[[k]] <- res_df
  k <- k + 1
}

res_one_vs_rest <- bind_rows(one_vs_rest_list)


## 6) METTI TUTTE LE COMPARAZIONI IN UN’UNICA TABELLA
res_all <- bind_rows(res_pairwise, res_one_vs_rest)
```

#volcano plots for pseudobulk differential expression NANOG OVER only per monocle cluster (3, 4, 5)

```{r}
## palette dal tuo esempio
ok_pal <- c(
  "Up"   = "#CC79A7",
  "Down" = "#009E73",
  "NS"   = "grey70"
)

plot_volcano_enhanced <- function(
  comp,
  res_table   = res_all_NO,
  padj_thr    = 0.05,
  lfc_thr     = 1,
  left_label  = NULL,
  right_label = NULL,
  title       = NULL
) {
  ## subset dei risultati
  df <- res_table %>%
    filter(comparison == comp, !is.na(padj))
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0)
    stop("No results for comparison = ", comp)
  
  ## gestione etichette dei geni
  if ("gene_name" %in% colnames(df)) {
    lab_vec <- df$gene_name
  } else if ("gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    lab_vec <- df$gene
  } else {
    lab_vec <- rownames(df)
  }
  
  ## estrai nomi laterali automaticamente se NULL
  if (is.null(left_label) || is.null(right_label)) {
    parts <- strsplit(comp, "_vs_")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) == 2) {
      if (is.null(right_label)) right_label <- parts[1]
      if (is.null(left_label))  left_label  <- parts[2]
    } else {
      if (is.null(right_label)) right_label <- comp
      if (is.null(left_label))  left_label  <- ""
    }
  }
  
  ## titolo di default
  if (is.null(title))
    title <- comp
  
  ## range per scritte laterali
  x_min <- min(df$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(df$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(-log10(df$padj), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ## costruisci volcano stile EnhancedVolcano
  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    df,
    lab = lab_vec,
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'padj',
    pCutoff  = padj_thr,
    FCcutoff = lfc_thr,
    
    title    = title,
    subtitle = 'Volcano Plot',
    caption  = paste0('padj < ', padj_thr, '  |  |log2FC| > ', lfc_thr),
    
    pointSize = 2,
    
    ## colori personalizzati
    colCustom = ok_pal[df$direction],
    colAlpha  = 0.5,
    
    ## connettori
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.1,
    colConnectors   = 'black',
    
    ## label appearance
    labSize      = 2.5,
    boxedLabels  = FALSE,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    
    legendLabSize  = 10,
    legendIconSize = 3.5,
    borderWidth    = 0.1,
    axisLabSize    = 12
  ) +
    annotate("text",
             x = x_min * 0.5,
             y = y_max * 0.5,
             label = left_label,
             hjust = 0, size = 4,
             fontface = "bold", colour = "black") +
    annotate("text",
             x = x_max * 0.5,
             y = y_max * 0.5,
             label = right_label,
             hjust = 1, size = 4,
             fontface = "bold", colour = "black") +
    theme(
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

for (comp in unique(res_all$comparison)) {
  p <- plot_volcano_enhanced(comp)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_volcano_", comp, "_NO_pseudobulk.pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 6,
    height   = 7
  )
}
```

####GSEA on pseudobulk analysis
#NANOG OVER

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(DOSE)
library(dplyr)


res_all_NO$gene_name=res_all_NO$gene
set_min_n_genes <- 5

## prendi solo i confronti cluster vs rest
#cl_vs_rest <- unique(res_all$comparison[grepl("vs_rest$", res_all$comparison)])
cl_vs_rest <- unique(res_all_NO$comparison)
cl_vs_rest
# controlla che siano quelli che ti aspetti: es. "7_vs_rest", "3_vs_rest", ...

## Costruisci le ranked lists: named numeric vector (values = log2FC, names = SYMBOL)
gene_sets_GSEA <- list()

for (comp in cl_vs_rest) {
  df_comp <- res_all_NO %>%
    filter(comparison == comp, !is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) 
  
  ## usa gene_name come SYMBOL (se non l'hai, vedi commento sotto)
  df_comp <- df_comp %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "")
  
  if (!nrow(df_comp)) {
    message("No genes for comparison ", comp, " – skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  ranks <- df_comp$log2FoldChange
  names(ranks) <- df_comp$gene_name
  
  ## ordina decrescente come richiesto da gseGO
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  gene_sets_GSEA[[comp]] <- ranks
}

## Controllo di sicurezza
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && length(x) > 0 && !is.null(names(x))))
)

# Se NON hai `gene_name` ma solo `gene` con SYMBOL, sostituisci sopra `gene_name` con `gene`.
## Mappa tutti i SYMBOL che compaiono in qualsiasi ranked list
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]
  
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym),
                   rank   = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by = "SYMBOL")
  
  if (!nrow(df2)) {
    message("No ENTREZ mapping for ", nm, " – skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  ## deduplico per ENTREZ tenendo il gene con |rank| maggiore
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]
  
  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  gsea <- suppressMessages(
    gseGO(
      geneList      = ranks_entrez,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      ont           = "BP",
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      nPermSimple   = 10000,
      by            = "fgsea",
      verbose       = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  if (is.null(gsea) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea)) == 0L) {
    message("No enriched terms for ", nm)
    gsea_list[[nm]]   <- NULL
    GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  ## rendo leggibili i geni
  gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea,
                               OrgDb  = org.Hs.eg.db,
                               keyType = "ENTREZID")
  
  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea_readable
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

## 4a. Scrivi le tabelle GSEA in CSV
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GSEA_pseudobulk_NO_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

## 4b. Funzione helper per salvare plot
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

## 4c. Dotplot per ciascun confronto cluster vs rest
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10,
                               width = 8, height = 10) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    if (is.null(g)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (NULL).")
      next
    }
    
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }
    
    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))
    
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_pseudobulk_NO_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_GO, show_k = 15)
```

#Pseudobulk DE aggregation by sample and treatment (so I can compare WT E8 vs WT E6;NO E8 vs NO E6, WT E8 vs NO E8)

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)

seurat <- seurat_AB04
Idents(seurat) <- "monocle_clusters"
## COSTRUISCI meta_to_use DAL META.DATA DI SEURAT
meta_to_use <- seurat@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    samp,
    media,
    type,
  )

## Crea pb_group USANDO meta_to_use (non meta!)
meta_to_use$pb_group <- interaction(
  meta_to_use$sample_id,
  meta_to_use$samp,
  sep  = "__",
  drop = TRUE
)

## Scrivi pb_group dentro Seurat (stesso ordine delle celle)
seurat$pb_group <- meta_to_use$pb_group
## COSTRUISCI pb_meta come nel tuo schema (usa esattamente gli stessi campi)
pb_meta <- meta_to_use %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pb_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sample_id        = dplyr::first(sample_id),
    samp             = dplyr::first(samp),
    media            = dplyr::first(media),
    type             = dplyr::first(type),
    n_cells          = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pb_group")


###aggregate counts per sample×cluster
agg <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat,
  assays  = "originalexp",  # o l'assay giusto
  slot    = "counts",
  group.by = "pb_group",
  fun     = "sum"
)

pb_counts <- as.matrix(agg$originalexp)

## 1) Porta i rownames di pb_meta nello stesso formato di pb_counts
rownames(pb_meta) <- gsub("_", "-", rownames(pb_meta))
# questo converte: cl6_WT_P2_E8_n3__7  ->  cl6-WT-P2-E8-n3--7

## 2) Diagnostica e allineamento robusto
pb_groups_counts <- colnames(pb_counts)
pb_groups_meta   <- rownames(pb_meta)

missing_in_meta   <- setdiff(pb_groups_counts, pb_groups_meta)
missing_in_counts <- setdiff(pb_groups_meta, pb_groups_counts)

cat("N groups in pb_counts: ", length(pb_groups_counts), "\n")
cat("N groups in pb_meta:   ", length(pb_groups_meta), "\n")
cat("Only in counts: ", length(missing_in_meta), "\n")
cat("Only in meta:   ", length(missing_in_counts), "\n")

# Usa solo i gruppi comuni (per sicurezza)
common_groups <- intersect(pb_groups_counts, pb_groups_meta)

if (length(common_groups) < 2) {
  stop("Too few common groups between pb_counts and pb_meta.")
}

pb_counts <- pb_counts[, common_groups, drop = FALSE]
pb_meta   <- pb_meta[common_groups, , drop = FALSE]

# Ordine identico
pb_meta <- pb_meta[colnames(pb_counts), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(pb_counts), rownames(pb_meta)))

## 2) PREPARE DESeq2
## IMPORTANT: set factor levels (these determine reference levels in the model)
pb_meta$media <- factor(pb_meta$media, levels = c("E6_FGF", "E8"))          # reference = E6_FGF
pb_meta$type  <- factor(pb_meta$type,  levels = c("WT", "NANOG_OVER"))      # reference = WT

## Single DESeq2 dataset with interaction
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb_counts),
  colData   = pb_meta,
  design    = ~ type + media + type:media
)

# Filter low-expressed genes
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]

# Fit
dds <- DESeq(dds)

## PCA with VST (optional)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("media", "type"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color = media, shape = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% var")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% var")) +
  theme_bw()

p_pca
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_", "PCA_pseudobulk_samp_all.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
```

#####build comparisons
1) analyze dds_NO to compare NANOG_OVER (already sampled) between media E8 vs E6_FGF;
2)analyze dds_WT to compare WT (already sampled) between media E8 vs E6_FGF;
3) analyze dds_E8 to compare E8 treated (already sampled) between type WT vs NANOG_OVER. 

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
})


alpha <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 1   # set to 0 if you want "Up/Down" purely by sign, without effect-size threshold

# --- Get coefficient names robustly ---
rn <- resultsNames(dds)
rn

coef_mediaE8 <- rn[grepl("^media_", rn) & grepl("E8", rn)]
coef_typeNO  <- rn[grepl("^type_",  rn) & grepl("NANOG_OVER", rn)]
coef_int     <- rn[grepl("type.*NANOG_OVER.*media.*E8", rn)]

stopifnot(length(coef_mediaE8) == 1, length(coef_typeNO) == 1, length(coef_int) == 1)

coef_mediaE8 <- coef_mediaE8[[1]]   # WT: E8 vs E6_FGF
coef_typeNO  <- coef_typeNO[[1]]    # NO vs WT at reference media (E6_FGF)
coef_int     <- coef_int[[1]]       # interaction term

# --- helper to make a clean annotated table ---
make_tbl <- function(res, label, alpha = 0.05, lfc_cut = 1) {
  as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = label,
      is_sig = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha,
      direction = case_when(
        is_sig & !is.na(log2FoldChange) & log2FoldChange >=  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
        is_sig & !is.na(log2FoldChange) & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}

# =========================
# Comparison 1) NANOG_OVER: E8 vs E6_FGF
# effect in NANOG_OVER = media(E8) + interaction
# =========================
res_NO_E8_vs_E6 <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(c(coef_mediaE8, coef_int)),
  alpha = alpha
)

tbl_NO_E8_vs_E6 <- make_tbl(
  res_NO_E8_vs_E6,
  label = "NANOG_OVER: E8 vs E6_FGF",
  alpha = alpha,
  lfc_cut = lfc_cut
)

# =========================
# Comparison 2) WT: E8 vs E6_FGF
# effect in WT = media(E8)
# =========================
res_WT_E8_vs_E6 <- results(
  dds,
  name = coef_mediaE8,
  alpha = alpha
)

tbl_WT_E8_vs_E6 <- make_tbl(
  res_WT_E8_vs_E6,
  label = "WT: E8 vs E6_FGF",
  alpha = alpha,
  lfc_cut = lfc_cut
)

# =========================
# Comparison 3) E8 only: NANOG_OVER vs WT
# type effect at E8 = type(NANOG_OVER) + interaction
# =========================
res_E8_NO_vs_WT <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(c(coef_typeNO, coef_int)),
  alpha = alpha
)

tbl_E8_NO_vs_WT <- make_tbl(
  res_E8_NO_vs_WT,
  label = "E8 only: NANOG_OVER vs WT",
  alpha = alpha,
  lfc_cut = lfc_cut
)

# Optional: write tables
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "DE_NO_E8_vs_E6_FGF.csv")
write.csv(tbl_NO_E8_vs_E6,filename, row.names = FALSE)
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "DE_WT_E8_vs_E6_FGF.csv")
write.csv(tbl_WT_E8_vs_E6,filename, row.names = FALSE)
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "DE_E8_only_NO_vs_WT.csv")
write.csv(tbl_E8_NO_vs_WT,filename, row.names = FALSE)

# Optional: unified table (all 3)
tbl_all3 <- bind_rows(tbl_NO_E8_vs_E6, tbl_WT_E8_vs_E6, tbl_E8_NO_vs_WT)
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "DE_pseudobulk_main_comparisons.csv")
write.csv(tbl_all3, filename, row.names = FALSE)
```

###GSEA analysis

```{r}

lfc_gsea=0.25 #low lfc to allow to get more genes in the GSEA
set_min_n_genes <- 5
alpha_gsea <- 0.05

tbl_all3$treshold = ifelse(tbl_all3$is_sig==TRUE &
      tbl_all3$log2FoldChange >= lfc_gsea, "Up",
      ifelse(
        tbl_all3$is_sig==TRUE & tbl_all3$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_gsea, "Down",
        "other"))
  
gsea_stat=subset(tbl_all3,tbl_all3$treshold!="other") #filter for sig and lfc (not necessary but it can reduce the computational time and noise)
#gsea_stat=tbl_all3 #unmute this if you do not want to filter for sig and lfc

genes_E8_NOvsWT=subset(gsea_stat,gsea_stat$comparison=="E8 only: NANOG_OVER vs WT")
genes_NO_E8vsE7=subset(gsea_stat,gsea_stat$comparison=="NANOG_OVER: E8 vs E6_FGF")
genes_WT_E8vsE7=subset(gsea_stat,gsea_stat$comparison=="WT: E8 vs E6_FGF")

genes <- genes_E8_NOvsWT$log2FoldChange
names(genes) <- genes_E8_NOvsWT$gene
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_E8_NOvsWT=genes

genes <- genes_NO_E8vsE7$log2FoldChange
names(genes) <- genes_NO_E8vsE7$gene
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_NO_E8vsE7=genes

genes <- genes_WT_E8vsE7$log2FoldChange
names(genes) <- genes_WT_E8vsE7$gene
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_WT_E8vsE7=genes

gene_sets_GSEA <- list(
  "E8_NOvsWT"    = genes_E8_NOvsWT,
  "NO_E8vsE7"    = genes_NO_E8vsE7,
  "WT_E8vsE7"  = genes_WT_E8vsE7)

# Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZ, then rebuild ranked vectors in ENTREZ space
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(bitr(
  unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
  fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db
))

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  # join to map to ENTREZ
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym), rank = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by="SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) next

  # deduplicate ENTREZ if necessary (keep max |rank|)
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea <- gseGO(geneList      = ranks_entrez,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = "ENTREZID",
                ont           = "BP",
                minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,#place this automatic
                maxGSSize     = 500,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 1,
                nPermSimple = 10000,# readable=TRUE,
                verbose       = FALSE, by = "fgsea")
  
gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

# filter significant terms
# Make a new list of GSEA results filtered by significance
gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # filter by adjusted p-value < 0.05
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  
  # replace the result slot with filtered df
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# 1) Write every GO table to CSV: GO_<name>.csv
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    # file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_GO_", nm, ".csv"))
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GSEA_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# Helper: save ggplot if it exists
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w=8, h=10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# Make a dotplot per GSEA result in gsea_list
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width=8, height=10) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    # Skip NULL or empty results
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }

    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))

    # GSEA-friendly dotplot: split by .sign for up/down, order by NES
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) { message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
    )

    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_GO, show_k = 15)
```
